field_sampling.index_order: x fastest, then y, then z
field_sampling.method: Exact saved values at indices 0,5,10,... on each axis; no averaging or interpolation.

units.field_values: normalized extracellular AAV density; source declares normalized, integral uses voxel volume in µm³
units.editing_fraction: dimensionless fraction; multiply by 100 for percent
units.off_target_burden: dimensionless accumulated off-target events / total modeled APOE pool

provenance.interpretation: Saved numerical simulations with configurable demonstration priors, not calibrated in vivo or clinical predictions. One-way PBPK input drives a tissue microdomain; this is not a whole-human anatomy or fluid-flow simulation.

metric_definitions.editing_fraction: (S_APOE3_like + S_APOE2_like) / (four free APOE states + four complexes + 1e-12)
metric_definitions.brain_cell_editing_mean: Arithmetic mean over 800 neurons and 400 astrocytes; excludes endothelial cells.
metric_definitions.off_target_burden: (B_local_bystander + E_puf_off + E_deaminase_bg) / total modeled APOE pool
metric_definitions.near_far: Near/far are bottom/top quartiles of cell distance to vessel among brain cells, not fixed distance thresholds.
